record_title: Isolated-unit criterion for isotropy embeddings in Steinberg algebras
provenance: A topological criterion identifies exactly when isotropy singletons are Steinberg-algebra elements, yielding a sharp correction and a corner-based module formulation for isotropy restriction.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The isolated-unit criterion is elementary and may be implicit in foundational Steinberg-algebra literature; the novelty claim is restricted to the sharp criterion together with its application to the unrestricted singleton embedding and unital restriction framework in arXiv:2609.20230v1. No independent validation is asserted.
